name: gobananas-mcp

tools.name: go_bananas_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose Go Bananas MCP connectivity, OAuth subscription access, authorization, and upstream status.

instructions: Image routing: first call get_subscription_status. If connected=true, use generate_with_subscription; otherwise, and for edits, use generate_image and other image tools with workspace keys; don't ask or tell users to connect ChatGPT. If the subscription can't run (disconnected, no allowance), use generate_image with generation_lane=provider and say the keys were used. If ChatGPT declined the prompt, say so; don't retry. Results save to the gallery; pass project to image tools only when the user names one.
